references.title: Requirements or prerequisites authoring
references.question: Q3
references.take: Udemy’s Intended learners step visibly asks authors what requirements or prerequisites learners should have before taking the course, with a dedicated response area.

references.title: Intended learners guidance
references.question: Q5
references.take: Udemy’s Intended learners step states that at least four learning objectives or outcomes are required, shows per-field character counts, and provides a prerequisite example placeholder: “No programming experience needed. You will learn everything you need to know.”
